_doc: Per-drill human overrides for the assignment engine. Keys: question_types, question_features, reasoning_types, question_count, difficulty_min, difficulty_max, blended, question_qids, note. Anything omitted falls back to audit recommendation -> seed. Engine: scripts/assign-guided-drill-taxonomy.mjs.

w3-08-describing-arguments-set-1.note: Describing-the-argument drill. Identity is the describe-the-argument question types, not the Focused-on-Evidence feature the engine fell back to.

w2-03-must-be-true-first-taste.note: Must Be True first taste. Keep the type; do not let the generic Ruling Out Options feature drop it.

w2-09-most-supported-first-taste.note: Most Supported first taste. Keep the Most Strongly Supported type.

w4-02-principle-strengthen-application-s.note: Seed had null count; card says 'these five Principle-Strengthen questions'.

w1-02-the-core-connection.note: Count 7 from curriculum source ('Try these 7 questions, untimed'). Assumption-family blended set; types/feature derive.

w5-10-evaluate-first-taste.note: Accept: Evaluate is a small bank (~26 total LR). Type is right; pool spans all levels.

w8-11-must-be-false-medium-set-2.note: Accept: Must Be False is a small bank (~18 total LR). Type is right.

w9-06-must-be-false-harder-set-2.note: Accept: small Must Be False bank.

w8-03-must-be-false-medium-set-1.note: Count 4 from curriculum source ('a set of four Must Be False questions, taken from tests 52, 56, 57'). Small Must Be False bank.

w1-06-explain-curious-fact-first-taste.note: LSAT Lab classifies Explain Curious Fact as a CAUSATION feature (not the Paradox type). Feature-driven; question types derive from the actual ECF questions (mixed).

w7-01-explain-curious-fact-medium-set-2.note: ECF = Causation feature. Feature-driven, types derived.

w7-05-explain-curious-fact-medium-set-3.note: ECF = Causation feature. Feature-driven, types derived.

w11-02-explain-curious-fact-harder-set-2.note: ECF = Causation feature. Feature-driven, types derived.
